statement: ∀ r : ℝ≥0∞, 0 < r → ∃ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ ∧ ENNReal.ofReal δ ≤ r
proof:
intro r hr
by_cases ht : r = ∞
· exact ⟨1, zero_lt_one, by simp [ht]⟩
· refine ⟨r.toReal / 2, half_pos (ENNReal.toReal_pos (ne_of_gt hr) ht), ?_⟩
  calc
    ENNReal.ofReal (r.toReal / 2) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal r.toReal := ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal (by positivity)
    _ = r := ENNReal.ofReal_toReal ht
